patch_description:
This version keeps the productive 3-fold triangular geometry of the current program, but replaces its single current-to-best differential evolution loop with a mixed mutation portfolio and an active-constraint bundle polish.

The convex hull is now explicitly scaled to have area exactly one. Global exploration uses three complementary donor styles: broad difference vectors, current-to-elite attraction, and elite-difference moves. Selection uses a lower-tail merit early in the search so configurations improve several nearly active triangles rather than only one unstable minimum constraint.

After global search, a deterministic soft-min bundle refinement estimates a smooth ascent direction from all tight triangles using finite differences in normalized radius/phase coordinates. Every candidate is still accepted only when it improves the true minimum normalized triangle area, preserving the primary objective.
